current_stances.position: Ubique reinforces its view that affective and defensive expressions involve both voluntary simulation and involuntary components such as peri-ocular muscle contractions, as detailed in observational evidence.

Ubique holds that tear secretion is primarily triggered by strong involuntary contraction of the peri‑ocular muscles that compresses blood vessels, serving a protective function; emotional tears represent a later, culturally co‑opted use of this reflex.
